node.title: Re: IO::Socket simple server
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
If you want to keep waiting on data from the client, you need to keep reading from the client. See for example [doc://perlipc#TCP-Servers-with-IO::Socket|"TCP Servers with IO::Socket" in perlipc].

However, I would strongly recommend against writing a server at such a low level. Nowadays, I think that event loops are the way to go. I've used [mod://POE], but that has a fairly high learning curve, and so I can recommend [mod://Mojo::IOLoop]. Yes [mod://Mojolicious] is a web framework, but the aforementioned module can be used independently of the framework to write TCP servers IMHO very easily. [id://11113259|Example code here.]
